description: Source code for Playwright server implementation, managing WebSocket connections, browser instances, and launch options.

classes.name: PlaywrightServer
classes.description: Main class managing the Playwright server, WebSocket connections, and browser instances.

methods.name: _initReuseBrowsersMode
methods.description: Reuses existing browsers matching criteria or launches new one.

methods.name: _initConnectMode
methods.description: Initializes a connection in 'connect' mode, possibly launching a new browser.

methods.name: _initPreLaunchedBrowserMode
methods.description: Uses a pre-launched browser for incoming connections.

methods.name: _initLaunchBrowserMode
methods.description: Launches a new browser with specified options.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Starts the WebSocket server listening on specified port and hostname.
